413-1981-3188.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-3188.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-677-7296-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-1753-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

1432-2645-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-2113-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-2113-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

6495-6517-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6517-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-3025-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1621-1739-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2946-4871-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2438-2946-4871-6248.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1902-7730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-7730.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

725-1432-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Vhal and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

1170-2642-4050-7525.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Pigment Wrangler // Striking Palette, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

27-413-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
27-413-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

280-423-433-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
280-423-433-1437--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-2836-3832.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
You control a basic Plains or Island.
2757-2836-3832.description:
Activate a basic Plains or Island by tapping it, adding {W/U}
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Puresight Merrow, untapping the basic Plains or Island.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

4038-5963-7066.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kyoshi's ability by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

3490-3499-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3499-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1437-6962.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-6962.description:
Cast Glistening Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Glistening Sphere spell three times.
Resolve the first Glistening Sphere spell.
When the Glistening Sphere token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-6962.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Glistening Sphere spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

874-4195-4574-6918.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4195-4574-6918.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5231.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5231.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

2-5637-6753.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2829-2866-4986-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

232-2034-2532-5200.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
232-2034-2532-5200.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Priest of Urabrask token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.

5256-6431--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

372-2417-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2417-4477.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

790-886-1371-2836.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least eight cards in hand, or an opponent except the opponent directly to your right has at least six cards in hand.
Your deck size is less than 90, or each opponent has a deck size of 91 or less.
790-886-1371-2836.description:
Cast Pure Intentions by paying {W}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Pure Intentions.
Resolve all Pure Intentions.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Windfall.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Windfall, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way.
Each player who did not control Windfall's Pure Intentions triggers.
Resolve all Pure Intentions, causing you and the opponents to return to their hand all cards discarded by Windfall.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Windfall until you either draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac, or until your opponents lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1082-1769-2034.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rot Hulk, adding {C}{C}.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all tokens named Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger from step 2, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
The token copy of Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1545-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2567-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
2034-2567-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Avenger of Zendikar.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Emiel the Blessed.
Resolve Emiel the Blessed's ability, choosing not to pay for it.
Resolve Avenger of Zendikar's ability, creating at least two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Emiel the Blessed triggers once for each token; choose not to pay for its ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Plant tokens, adding {4}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Emiel the Blessed any number of times.
